code: local o={} for _,m in ipairs(workspace.Phase1Map.town1_extra:GetDescendants()) do if m:IsA('Model') then local cf,sz=m:GetBoundingBox() table.insert(o,string.format('MODEL %s pos=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) size=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) yaw=%.0f', m:GetFullName(), cf.X,cf.Y,cf.Z, sz.X,sz.Y,sz.Z, math.deg(select(2, cf:ToEulerAnglesYXZ())))) end if m:IsA('BasePart') then table.insert(o,string.format('  part %s %s size=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) mat=%s col=%s cf=%s', m.Name, m.ClassName, m.Size.X,m.Size.Y,m.Size.Z, m.Material.Name, tostring(m.Color), tostring(m.CollisionFidelity))) end end return table.concat(o,'\n')
